pattern_types: Unwanted: IF [condition] THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT [behavior]
key_fields: pattern: EarsPattern - one of 6 pattern types
ears_insights.parsing_approach: Parse text line-by-line, match against regex patterns for each EARS type, extract components (trigger/state/condition/behavior), return EarsParseResult with requirements/errors/warnings

intent_behavior_type.description: IntentBehavior already has preconditions and postconditions as List(String)
intent_behavior_type.note: This exists in ears_parser as a target type for conversion from EARS to Intent behaviors

contract_insights.check_structure: Check type has two fields: rule (String) - validation expression, why (String) - explanation. This is essentially a postcondition with rationale.
contract_insights.behavior_checks: Behavior.response.checks is Dict(String, Check) - named validation rules that must pass after response
contract_insights.precondition_extraction: Behavior.requires field (List(String)) represents dependencies/preconditions - behaviors that must complete first
contract_insights.postcondition_extraction: Each Check in response.checks represents a postcondition. The 'rule' is the condition, 'why' is the contract rationale.
contract_insights.contract_relationship: Check.rule + Check.why form a contract specification: 'response must satisfy [rule] because [why]'

current_fields: ai_hints: String - single string with implementation guidance
dependencies: List(String) - other bead titles that must complete first

current_generation_patterns.api_beads: Extract from answers containing 'endpoint'/'path', generic acceptance_criteria about status codes and schemas
current_generation_patterns.cli_beads: Extract from answers containing 'command'/'subcommand', generic criteria about parsing and help text
current_generation_patterns.generic_hints: ai_hints are template strings like 'Use interview response to build OpenAPI spec'

enhancement_opportunities: Replace generic ai_hints string with structured EARS patterns
Replace generic acceptance_criteria with specific contract specifications (pre/post conditions)
Add type definitions needed for implementation
Add specific test cases derived from behavior checks
Link beads to specific Behavior definitions from specs
bead_insights.limitation: Current BeadRecord doesn't have structured fields for EARS/contracts/types/tests - currently all bundled in strings

integration_points.description: Extend BeadRecord with structured fields: ears_patterns: List(EarsRequirement), contracts: BeadContracts, type_definitions: List(TypeDef), test_cases: List(TestCase)
integration_points.rationale: Keep existing BeadRecord for backward compatibility, add enhanced version for rich AI context

integration_points.description: Create function that takes Behavior and generates EnhancedBeadRecord by extracting: (1) EARS from behavior.intent, (2) Contracts from response.checks, (3) Types from request/response schemas, (4) Tests from checks
integration_points.rationale: Specs contain all the information needed - just need extraction logic

integration_points.description: Enhanced generator can coexist with existing generators. Add new command 'beads-enhanced' or flag '--enhanced' to beads command

recommended_approach.step1: Define new types: EnhancedBeadRecord, BeadContracts, TestCase
recommended_approach.step2: Create enhanced_bead_generator.gleam module with pure functions
recommended_approach.step3: Implement extract_contracts_from_behavior(behavior: Behavior) -> BeadContracts - parse behavior.response.checks into structured contracts
recommended_approach.step4: Implement extract_ears_from_intent(intent: String) -> List(EarsPattern) - parse behavior.intent using EARS parser patterns
recommended_approach.step5: Implement generate_type_definitions(behavior: Behavior) -> List(String) - infer types from request/response
recommended_approach.step6: Implement generate_test_cases(behavior: Behavior) -> List(TestCase) - convert checks to test scenarios
recommended_approach.step7: Implement generate_enhanced_bead(behavior: Behavior, profile: String) -> EnhancedBeadRecord - orchestrate all extractors
recommended_approach.step8: Add tests for each extractor function

Explicit error handling with Result types
